lumio.menu.title: Lumio
lumio.menu.keys.text: Accept: %s · Deny: %s · Menu: %s · Radial menu: %s · Zoom: %s. Change them under Options → Controls → Lumio.
lumio.menu.hud.text: Drag the elements to their place with the mouse, turn them on or off with a right click and change their size with the mouse wheel.
lumio.menu.about.fair.text: A server with Lumio receives the list of your mods (name, version, fingerprint of the file). When it asks, Lumio also tells it whether code was put into your game from outside (Java agents, foreign libraries and threads, classes without a file) and whether a program on its list of injectors is running. Only file names are sent, never folders. Nothing else on your computer is read.

lumio.menu.chat.text: Messages with your name or one of your words light up in the theme colour and get a coloured bar. Your own name in front of your own messages does not count.
